This page provides supplementary material for EC7210 Macroeconomics, a
first-semester course in the Master's Program in Economics at Stockholm
University, taught in fall 2026. Course information, lecture notes, and
slides are available on the [course page in Canvas](https://canvas.su.se/courses/13560).

## Lecture Notes 2 — Ramsey model

The scripts compute the transition from a given initial capital stock to
the steady state with constant productivity and population. They also
plot the transition path in the phase diagram.

- [MATLAB version (RamseyModel.m)](RamseyModel.m){download=""}
- [Python version (RamseyModel.py)](RamseyModel.py){download=""}

## Lecture Notes 4 — Real business cycle (RBC) models

The impulse-response scripts compute the responses illustrated in
Figures 1 and 2 of Lecture Notes 4. To compare the two calibrations,
run the script with different values of the labor-supply parameter
$\gamma$. The simulation scripts plot a short sample from the simulated
economy and compute the model moments reported in Table 1.

| Material | MATLAB | Python |
|:---------|:-------|:-------|
| Impulse responses | [rbc_ir.m](rbc_ir.m){download=""} | [rbc_ir.py](rbc_ir.py){download=""} |
| Simulation | [rbc_with_simulation.m](rbc_with_simulation.m){download=""} | [rbc_with_simulation.py](rbc_with_simulation.py){download=""} |
